inputs.label: Mega Man 64 ROM (USA)
inputs.help: Your own Mega Man 64 (US) ROM as .z64.

steps.why: The guide runs the game once so it creates Android/data/com.megaman64recomp.vr/files.

steps.text: Open Mega Man 64 VR from Library > Unknown Sources. It imports the ROM on this start and then deletes the copy.

notes: Releases are all pre-releases. The guide accepts .z64, .n64 or .v64 ROMs but pushes to the fixed name MegaMan64.us.rev1.z64; whether the importer accepts a byte-swapped ROM under a .z64 name is unknown, so the input takes .z64 only. Optional PC save import (megaman.n64.us.1.0.bin to files/saves/) is not modelled.
